question: Is the value-span-v1 type regression caused by the name-first lend/borrow direction imbalance that targeted-value-01 added to training, and does restoring that balance pass the frozen regression gate while keeping value quality?
out_of_scope: architecture, loss weights, seed selection, export-seed rule, tokenizer/compression/KD, numeric normalization, date-after-amount examples, any augmentation from test/probe notes, a second repair iteration

diagnosis.class_counts: borrow/lend are balanced at class level in every batch (targeted-value-01: borrow 23, lend 21)
diagnosis.finding: name-first direction family: v1 training rows have 22 lender-first borrow (`X cho mượn`) vs 17 borrower-first lend (`X mượn`), difference 5. targeted-value-01 adds 8 lender-first borrow and 0 borrower-first lend (its 21 lend rows are all `cho X mượn`, 8 of them minimal pairs with its `X cho mượn` rows), so the merged difference is 13

repair.rule: append verbatim duplicates of existing non-targeted-value-01 training rows in family B_X_muon with type lend and a complete value label, until the name-first difference returns to its pre-targeted-value-01 value (5). N = 13 - 5 = 8. Order sha256('value-span-v2-direction-repair:<id>'), distinct value surfaces first. Labels are copied unchanged; no label created or edited; ids get suffix '#direction-repair-dup'

rows.text: bạn thân hỏi mượn 3tr, đã ck
cau Hai vay 3 trieu, thang sau tra
Thảo vay mình 1tr5, tuần sau trả
thg Binh vay t 2tr hen luong ve tra

repair.not_changed: validation, test and probe are byte-identical copies of training-v1

data.train: train.jsonl: 903 rows = training-v1 train (895) + 8 duplicates; sha256 2e2d02e453e4d89a52b8ebf48b4b9761c868dea38d71ba2b80c96e390c178d7b

architecture.encoder: pretrained BamiBERT-derived 4x768 (layers 2,5,8,11), FFN 2048 (models/compression-v3/ffn/combined-K2048), 34 position rows, vocabulary B-rank-8000, max_length 32
architecture.init: same initial_model(seed) as compression-v3 (pretrained pruned encoder, not the fine-tuned v1 checkpoint); type and target heads bit-identical to v1 for the same seed; value head (768x3, 2,307 params) from its own generator seeded 1_000_003 + seed

training.recipe: compression-v3 supervised recipe unchanged: AdamW, encoder lr 5e-5, head lr 1e-3, batch 8, 40 epochs, warmup 0.1, weight decay 0.01, dropout 0.1, max grad norm 1.0
training.loss: type CE + target BIO CE + value BIO CE, equal weights; each logged separately per epoch (train and validation)
training.command: uv run python scripts/train_value_student.py --train datasets/annotation-v2/training-v2-direction-repair/train.jsonl --validation datasets/annotation-v2/training-v2-direction-repair/validation.jsonl --seed 1 --seed 2 --seed 3 --out-dir models/value-span-v2-direction-repair --weights-dir models/value-span-v2-direction-repair
training.command_note: --weights-dir added before any training step: the first launch without it stopped at startup because the weights dir defaults to models/value-span-v1 (FileExistsError, nothing written)

selection.checkpoint: last epoch; no early stopping, no checkpoint selection
selection.export_seed: seed 1 (predeclared, as in deployment-v1); test/probe never pick the seed
selection.reported: mean and per-seed for every metric

metrics.full_joint: type correct AND target exact AND value exact
metrics.value_scoring_set: value_status == complete records; reported on all complete labels and separately on human-provenance labels only

value_slices: unseen exact surface span vs train
long/multi-token amounts (>2 v1 tokens or containing a space)
inspection: every multi-number value error on test and probe is listed and inspected by hand in the report

regression_vs_v1.baseline: frozen compression-v3 seeds 1-3 (seed 1 = gidi-finance-v1), scored with the same metric code on the same records
checks: probe lender-first X cho muon/vay slice
regression_vs_v1.material_regression: mean over seeds drops by more than 2 notes on the 105-note test (type accuracy, target exact or joint: > 0.019) or more than 2 notes on probe joint (> 0.025), OR seed 1 alone drops by more than 3 notes on any of those, OR the lender-first probe slice loses more than 1 note on mean type accuracy

value_quality: test value exact (complete labels, mean over seeds) >= 0.95
test value exact on human-provenance labels >= 0.90
no value slice with n >= 5 on test below 0.80 exact
adoption_criteria.regression: no material regression vs v1 (definition above)

verdict.A: value_quality and regression both pass: adopt gidi-finance-v2 with value-span head
verdict.B: value_quality passes, regression fails: value-span works but type/target regressions need fixing
verdict.C: value_quality fails: value-span quality is not sufficient yet

evaluation.command: uv run python scripts/compare_value_v1.py --experiment value-span-v2-direction-repair --v2-dir models/value-span-v2-direction-repair --data-dir datasets/annotation-v2/training-v2-direction-repair --protocol experiments/value-span-v2-direction-repair/protocol.json --out experiments/value-span-v2-direction-repair
evaluation.also_reported: per-note type/target changes vs value-span-v1 on test-v1 and probe; whether `ck cho Vũ mượn 700k` is fixed in all seeds; lender-first probe slice vs v1 and value-span-v1; per-gold-type accuracy changes. No subject-first-lend slice is defined in the frozen evaluation data, so none is added

verdict.A: value_quality and regression both pass: proceed to gidi-finance-v2 export, hardening, runtime and playground; gidi-finance-v1 unchanged
verdict.B: value_quality passes, regression fails: stop, keep as evidence
verdict.C: value_quality fails: stop, keep as evidence

known_limitations: most value labels are rule-provenance accepted by stratum audit (0 errors in sampled strata); value metrics on them measure agreement with audited rule labels, so the human-only slice is reported separately
slices are small on test (xi 2, chai 3, lit 1, ty 0, bare 6); slice results are directional
test has 0 complete no_amount labels; null-value accuracy is measured on validation (2) and is not an adoption gate
2 trieu ruoi form is absent from all splits
the frozen v1 validation is in train, as in v1; only the 39 targeted-value-01 validation rows are held out
family regexes are lexical; a few rows are misfiled (e.g. self-first `mình mượn Huy` lands in B_X_muon as borrow); only B_X_muon lend rows are duplicated
duplication reweights 8 existing rows; it adds no new wording
